search.name: Search notes
search.desc: Moves the cursor to the search box in the sidebar. On a narrow screen it opens the sidebar first.

searchClear.name: Clear the search
searchClear.desc: In the search box, clears what you typed and brings back the sidebar sections.

saveVersion.name: Save current version
saveVersion.desc: On a note you can edit, saves the current content as a version. You can give it a name.

openSettings.name: Open settings
openSettings.desc: Opens your settings. It does nothing while another dialog or menu is open.

slashMenu.name: Insert menu
slashMenu.desc: Type it to pick what to insert: headings, lists, tables, images, diagrams, columns and more.

wikilink.name: Link to another note
wikilink.desc: Type it, then part of the title, and press Enter to pick the note. The other note gets a backlink.

markdownLink.name: Link to a web address
markdownLink.desc: Write [text](https://…). It turns into a link as soon as you type the closing parenthesis.

heading.name: Headings
heading.desc: At the start of an empty paragraph, # is heading 1, ## is heading 2 and ### is heading 3. It goes up to ###### for heading 6. Add a space after the marks.

bullet.name: Bulleted list
bullet.desc: At the start of an empty paragraph, type -, * or + and a space.

numbered.name: Numbered list
numbered.desc: At the start of an empty paragraph, type 1. and a space.

checklist.name: To-do list
checklist.desc: At the start of an empty paragraph, [] and a space makes an unchecked to-do. [x] and a space makes a checked one.

quote.name: Quote
quote.desc: At the start of an empty paragraph, type > and a space.

codeBlock.name: Code block
codeBlock.desc: Type three backticks and a space. To pick a language, write it before the space, for example ```ts.

divider.name: Divider
divider.desc: Type three dashes in an empty paragraph.

inlineCode.name: Inline code
inlineCode.desc: Put the text between backticks. The backticks disappear when you close them.

inlineMarks.name: Bold, italic, strikethrough
inlineMarks.desc: **bold** makes bold text, *italic* makes italic text and ~~strikethrough~~ strikes it out. The marks disappear when you close them.

link.name: Add a link
link.desc: With text selected, opens a box for the web address. It does not jump to search.

indent.name: Indent
indent.desc: Tab indents a list item or a paragraph. Shift Tab takes the indent back.

lineBreak.name: Line break
lineBreak.desc: Starts a new line inside the same paragraph.

moveBlock.name: Move a paragraph up or down
moveBlock.desc: The up arrow moves the paragraph with the cursor up one place. The down arrow moves it down one place.

columnsInsert.name: Insert columns
columnsInsert.desc: Type it and pick 2, 3 or 4 columns. The menu does not offer columns while the cursor is already inside a column.

columnBackspace.name: Backspace at the start of a column
columnBackspace.desc: Moves that paragraph into the previous column. In an empty column it deletes the column. When one column is left, the columns turn back into plain paragraphs.

columnDelete.name: Delete at the end of a column
columnDelete.desc: Brings the first paragraph of the next column up here. If the next column is empty, it deletes that column. When one column is left, the columns turn back into plain paragraphs.

columnUngroup.name: Ungroup columns
columnUngroup.desc: In the ⋮⋮ menu next to a paragraph, choose “Ungroup columns” to put the columns back in a stack.

columnsDragBeside.name: Drag ⋮⋮ to a block's left or right edge
columnsDragBeside.desc: Drop it on another block's left or right edge to put the two side by side. Undo once (Ctrl+Z, ⌘Z on a Mac) to put them back.

columnResizeKeys.name: Resize columns (divider focused)
columnResizeKeys.desc: With the divider between two columns focused, the right arrow makes the left column wider and the right one narrower; the left arrow does the opposite. Undo once (Ctrl+Z, ⌘Z on a Mac) to undo several quick presses.

selectEsc.name: Leave select mode
selectEsc.desc: Works when the focus is in the sidebar or nowhere in particular. It does nothing while you are typing in a note or another text box.

selectRange.name: Select a range
selectRange.desc: In select mode, click one note, then hold Shift and click another to select everything between them.

presentNav.name: Move through slides
presentNav.desc: The right arrow goes to the next chapter and the left arrow to the previous one. The down arrow goes to the next section and the up arrow to the previous one.

presentOverview.name: Overview
presentOverview.desc: Shows all the slides. Press Esc to close the overview.

presentFullscreen.name: Full screen
presentFullscreen.desc: Switches full screen on or off. Presenting from the menu starts in full screen, so the first press leaves it.

aiSelect.name: Run an AI action
aiSelect.desc: In a note you can edit, select some text and click the AI button on the toolbar to run an AI action your site has set up.

aiSend.name: Send an instruction
aiSend.desc: In “AI on selection”, Enter sends your instruction and Shift Enter starts a new line.

dragBlock.name: Drag a paragraph
dragBlock.desc: Drag the ⋮⋮ handle next to a paragraph to move it somewhere else.

dragBlockCopy.name: Copy a paragraph by dragging
dragBlockCopy.desc: Hold Ctrl (Option on Mac) while dragging ⋮⋮ to drop a copy.

dragNoteToEditor.name: Link by dragging
dragNoteToEditor.desc: Drag a note from the sidebar into the text to insert a link to it.

dragNoteToFolder.name: Move into a folder
dragNoteToFolder.desc: Drag a note onto a folder. Hold it over another note to see a new folder holding both. Let go, name the folder, and it is created.

tour.heading: Feature tour
tour.intro: A short walk through Knotebook's main features. It creates a sample note in My notes and demonstrates on it.

whatsNew.heading: New in v{{version}}
whatsNew.empty: Nothing new to highlight in this version.

customColors.title: Custom colors
customColors.desc: Pick any color for text and highlights from the Custom option in the color menus; the last 8 you used are remembered. Table cells can be colored too, from the cell menu and the row and column handle menus.

sideBySideColumns.title: Side-by-side columns
sideBySideColumns.desc: Drag a block by its ⋮⋮ handle onto the left or right edge of another block to make columns, up to four. Drag the divider, or press the left and right arrow keys on it, to change the widths.

confirmRemoveMember.title: Confirm before removing a member
confirmRemoveMember.desc: The trash button in the group member list and in the share panel now asks you to confirm first.

signOutThisBrowser.title: Log out only this browser
signOutThisBrowser.desc: Logging out now only logs out the browser you used; your other browsers stay logged in.

siteLimits.title: Site limits in the browser (site admins)
siteLimits.desc: Site admins can adjust 15 limits on the Site limits page, and tune "Session and tokens" on the Sign-in page.
